title: Warm Rich Italian Ground Meat Ragu
description: A rich and flavorful Italian dish featuring ground meat in a thick and savory sauce, perfect for a crowd, this recipe is macrobiotic-friendly and made with ground nut oil and no refined sugars, instead using a touch of honey as a natural sweetener, although it does not contain any candy as that would not be macrobiotic-friendly
instructions: Heat the ground nut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, dried basil, dried oregano, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together, about 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the sauce to your desired consistency, or leave it chunky if you prefer.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the ragu hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or basil if desired.
